use_case_summary: Veridian supports federal emergency contact centers and 24/7 incident response lines. Primary asks: agent assist (real-time suggested replies + knowledge retrieval), automated ticket summarization for audit trails, tool-calling to their on-prem CRM via secure RPC, and predictable reliability during national-scale spikes.
technical_requirements:
- Must operate completely air-gapped with zero external egress.
- Offline model bundle install; team needs signed binary + checksums.
- HSM-backed key management (FIPS 140-2/3).
- STIG/SCAP or equivalent hardening on appliance.
- Target latency: agent-assist 95th <= 250ms for 256-token responses; preferred <= 200ms.
- Scale: steady 150 concurrent agents, burst to 600 for declared events.
- Ability to pin model version, local quantized variants (4-bit) for resource-constrained appliances.
- Audit logs and immutable transcript retention for 7 years; configurable retention controls.
- No outbound telemetry; all metrics must be push-pulled to local Prometheus/Grafana endpoints only.
- Integration: SSO via SAML with IdP in the tenant, ticket update tool-calls to legacy on-prem Remedy via secure connector.
